reason: The README clearly presents this plugin as a vision and image-processing router for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents, with structured visual tools and model-provider fallback routing.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 文本代理提供图像路由、视觉分析及 OCR、裁剪、像素比较和截图等图像处理工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness text agents with image routing, visual analysis, and image tools for OCR, cropping, pixel comparison, and screenshots.

capabilities: Routes image turns from DeepSeek Harness agents to vision models
Performs visual question answering, grounding, cropping, pixel comparison, color analysis, OCR, SVG tracing, foreground cutout, and HTML screenshots
Uses configured vision providers and a built-in anonymous fallback endpoint
Installs and integrates a DSH plugin bundle with model routing and attachment handling
